description: When database storage reaches 90% of max_storage_bytes, eviction is triggered automatically; expired records are deleted respecting retention_days_traces and retention_days_metrics; aggregate_stats are never deleted

preconditions.description: The periodic eviction job runs and detects storage usage at or above 90% threshold

expectedOutcome.description: Old tool_call_records and task_analysis_results beyond retention are deleted; aggregate_stats remain unchanged; storage usage decreases below threshold
